title: 85 ##### 4.3.2 Disposal of persons arrested under the local & special laws A total of 41,85,909 persons were under trial during 1980, including those under trial carried over from the previous year. 32.7 percent of the total under trials in custody remained in custody pending completion of trials at the end of the year, while 83.1 percent of the total persons, in whose cases trials were completed, were convicted during the year. The percentage of conviction to total persons whose trials were completed was consistently high, and for most of the offences it was above 70.0 percent, except for offences under the 'Prevention of Corruption Act', 'Prohibition Act', 'Explosive and Explosive Substances Act' and 'Customs Act' in which the convictions recorded were 34.6 percent, 43.9 percent, 56.9 percent and 68.4 percent respectively. The relevant statistics may be seen in Table 29.
